name: Agricultural Investment Grant (in Case of Crop Damage of 33% or More)
benefit:
Under this scheme:

  - ₹8,500/- per hectare is provided for Agriculture, Horticulture, and Annual Crops in unirrigated areas. A minimum of ₹1,000/- is payable.
  - ₹17,000/- per hectare is provided for Areas with Assured Irrigation. The minimum amount of assistance payable to any farmer will be ₹2,000/-.
  - For Evergreen Crops - ₹22,500/- per hectare is admissible for all types of evergreen crop
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident farmer of Uttarakhand engaged in agricultural activities within the state. 1. The financial assistance will be applicable only for the area actually sown with crops.
